title: BlogArticle
description: The exact shape returned by BlogRssCollector.collect() / parse_rss_entries() (backend/src/trendbaker/collectors/blog_rss.py) — one row per Blog/RSS article, matching the shared `items` table column-for-column (supabase/migrations/20260724101100_build_tables.sql, see docs/db-schema.md). There is no separate blog-specific database table; this contract documents the collector's output before it is upserted into `items`.

source.description: Matches the shared items.source discriminator (youtube | blog | retailer). Always 'blog' for this collector — not per-feed.

source_id.description: The RSS/Atom guid (RSS) or id (Atom) when available, otherwise 'url-' followed by a deterministic sha256 hex digest of the article URL. Combined with source, this is the upsert key (unique(source, source_id) on items).

url.description: The article's own URL. Null if the feed entry had no link.

title.description: Null if the feed entry had no title.

body.description: A short feed-provided excerpt/summary only (RSS <description> or Atom <summary>), truncated to 1000 characters by the collector. Never the full article body — a full-content field such as RSS's <content:encoded> is never read.

author.description: The configured source's publication name (e.g. 'King Arthur Baking Blog'), matching how the shared items.author column is documented for every source ('channel / blog / brand', not a personal byline). Always set by the collector from its source configuration — never null, and not an individual writer's byline.

published_at.description: Parsed from RSS <pubDate> (RFC 822) or Atom <updated>/<published> (ISO 8601). Null if missing or unparseable.

region.description: Always null in the current collector — no region concept exists for Blog/RSS sources yet. Populating this is a deliberate future contract change, not a silent addition.

views.description: Always 0, never a real value. RSS/Atom feeds do not reliably expose engagement metrics, but trendbaker.models.Item types views/likes/comments_count as plain int (default 0), not int | None, so the collector cannot represent 'unavailable' as null under the current shared model. This is a known limitation, not a measured value — see the module docstring in trendbaker.collectors.blog_rss for the recommended (small, backward-compatible) model fix to loosen these three fields to int | None.

collected_at.description: When this collector run fetched the article. Always set.

raw.description: Feed metadata that doesn't belong as a top-level items column. Always includes feed_slug and feed_url (the machine slug and feed URL of the configured BlogSource — the human-readable name is carried in the top-level `author` field instead). RSS entries additionally include guid/link/pub_date; Atom entries include id/link/updated. Never contains full article body content.

feed_slug.description: The configured BlogSource's machine slug, e.g. 'king_arthur_baking'.

feed_url.description: The RSS/Atom feed URL this article was collected from.
